# DatePicker

DatePicker — a date field that opens a month calendar (Figma `DatePicker`). Built from the shared parts: the field is `FieldBox` with the calendar icon in Trailing, and the calendar is the shared `Calendar` on the `_Listbox` surface, which DateTimePicker opens too. - **Typing:** the field takes MM/DD/YYYY (and, with `range`, two dates joined by a dash). It is checked when you press Enter or leave the field: a real day inside `minDate`…`maxDate` is picked, anything else is kept as typed and marked invalid, and `onChange` is not called. - **Form value:** the field shows the text as typed, but `name` belongs to a hidden input holding the picked day as ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` (`start/end` with `range`), empty until a day is accepted. - **Range:** the first click sets the first day, the second the last; a click before the first day starts again. `onChange` receives `[start, end]`. - **Clearing:** when a value or typed text is in a live field, a subtle `xmark` icon button (`tabIndex={-1}`) sits before the calendar icon and a subtle "Clear" button (in the tab order) sits in the calendar footer. Both empty the field, call `onChange` with `''` (or `[null, null]` with `range`) when a pick was set, and keep focus in the input. - **Popup:** opens 4px (`--stack-sm`) below the field, left-aligned (or as `calendarAlign` asks), and flips above with the same gap when there is no room below. Props it does not name (`aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-describedby`, `data-*`) go to the input, which is the control a screen reader lands on. `label` does not name the plain field: it is the filter trigger's text and turns DatePicker into the filter popup. Name a plain field with `aria-label`, or a visible label tied to it with `htmlFor` and the field's `id`.

Also asked as: calendar input, date field, date input, date selector.

## Usage

Use `DatePicker` for a single date or a date range typed or chosen from a popup calendar, such as a session date or a billing period. The form value is ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` (`start/end` for a range); the field shows what was typed.

## Motion

DatePicker reads these motion tokens and no literal duration or curve.

| Event | Transition | Tokens | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| enter | Open and close an overlay | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Opens as a Popup: a fade in place. |
| exit | Open and close an overlay | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Fades. |
| change | Step to the next or previous | `--ds-motion-spatial-default` | A month change slides the grid flat. |

## Alternatives

- For a time of day with no date, use `TimePicker`.
- For a combined date and time answer, use `DateTimePicker`.
- For an always-visible month grid on the page, use `Calendar`.

## Best practices

### Typing is checked on Enter or on leaving the field. {#typing-is-checked-on-enter-or-on-leaving-the-field}

A real day inside `minDate` to `maxDate` is picked; anything else is kept exactly as typed and marked invalid, and `onChange` is not called until the text reads as a real date.

```jsx
<DatePicker
    value={date}
    onChange={setDate}
    minDate="2026-01-01"
    maxDate="2026-12-31"
/>
```

### A range is two clicks, not a drag. {#a-range-is-two-clicks-not-a-drag}

The first click sets the first day, the second sets the last day, and `onChange` receives `[start, end]`. A click before the first day starts the range again rather than erroring.

### Name the field. {#name-the-field}

`label` does not name a plain field: it is the filter trigger's text and turns `DatePicker` into the filter popup. Name a plain field with `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` (both go straight to the input), or a visible label tied to its `id` with `htmlFor`.

### Show the date format as a hint. {#show-the-date-format-as-a-hint}

The field says how to type the date before anyone types it. Without a hint people guess the order. The placeholder is MM/DD/YYYY unless you replace it, so leave it.

Do: The format is shown.
Don't: No format given.

### Show dates in one format everywhere. {#show-dates-in-one-format-everywhere}

Use the same order and separators in the field, the calendar and any message. Mixed formats read as different dates.

Do: One format throughout.
Don't: A second format appears in the message.

### Use one range field, not two dates. {#use-one-range-field-not-two-dates}

A range picks start and end in one field and one calendar. Two separate fields split one decision in two.

Do: One range field.
Don't: Two separate fields.

### Use read-only for fixed dates and disabled for unavailable ones. {#use-read-only-for-fixed-dates-and-disabled-for-unavailable-ones}

`isReadOnly` keeps the date focusable, selectable and at full contrast (`aria-readonly`); `isDisabled` removes the field from the tab order when it does not apply yet. Never swap one for the other, and never clip a read-only value; content nobody can edit is plain text, not a field. See [Read-only](?path=/docs/patterns-states-read-only--docs) and [Disabled](?path=/docs/patterns-states-disabled--docs).

Do: Read-only keeps the value readable, and the caption says why.
Don't: Disabled fades a value people need to read.

### Let a `DatePicker` value wider than its field end in an ellipsis. {#let-a-datepicker-value-wider-than-its-field-end-in-an-ellipsis}

The field is typed in, so it has no Tooltip: focus reaches the whole value. It keeps its height and stays inside its slot; give it room for the whole date. See [Overflow](?path=/docs/patterns-states-overflow--docs).

## Accessibility

- **The input is the named control.** `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby` and `aria-describedby` are forwarded to the text input (`role="combobox"`), which tracks the popup with `aria-expanded` and `aria-haspopup`.
- **Name a plain field with `aria-label` or a tied label.** `label` is the filter trigger's text, not the plain field's name: it turns `DatePicker` into the filter popup. Give a plain field `aria-label`, or a visible label tied to its `id` with `htmlFor`.
- **The calendar moves like a date grid.** One day is in the tab order; the arrow keys move by day and week, Home and End go to the start and end of the week, and Page Up and Page Down change month (with Shift, year). `Enter` picks the focused day.
- **The popup is a labeled dialog.** It opens as `role="dialog"` with `aria-label` "Choose a date" or "Choose dates".
- **Clearing by keyboard and screen reader.** When a live field holds a value or typed text, the field's plain ✕ `IconButton` (`xmark` at `--icon-sm`) is named `"Clear <noun>"` in lowercase (such as `"Clear start date"`, `"Clear date"` or `"Clear dates"`) and sets `tabIndex={-1}` so `Tab` moves past the field in one stop, while the popup footer's subtle "Clear" `Button` stays in the tab order. Keyboard users clear the text and press `Enter`, or `Tab` through the open calendar dialog to the footer "Clear" button; pointer and screen-reader users can activate either button. Both empty the field, call `onChange` with `''` (or `[null, null]` with `range`) when a pick was set, and return focus to the input.
- **Invalid input stays editable.** An invalid typed date keeps the typed text and sets `aria-invalid` so the person can correct it.

## Parts

1. **Field.** A 40 box (32 at compact) on the input fill, with the date as text.
2. **Clear button.** A subtle `IconButton` (`xmark` at `--icon-sm`) before the calendar icon when a date, range or typed text is in a live field (not read-only or disabled).
3. **Calendar icon.** Opens the calendar. Decoration for assistive technology; the input is the control.
4. **Calendar.** A month grid of 24px day cells (`--calendar-day-sm`) in a popup `--stack-sm` below the field, flipped above when there is no room. A picked day or range end is a filled square; days between form a continuous band that rounds where a week starts or ends.
5. **Presets and footer.** With `presets`, a 160px (`--width-1000`) column of 32px radio rows (`All time`, `Today`, `Last 7 days`, `Last 30 days`) sits beside the calendar with arrow-key navigation and `Enter`/`Space` selection, and presets outside `minDate`–`maxDate` are disabled. Compact `Clear` and `Apply` buttons sit below: `Clear` commits `[null, null]` immediately while `Apply` stays disabled until an in-bounds complete range (or `All time` over a non-empty filter) is ready. Otherwise, a compact subtle "Clear" `Button` sits at the end of the popup footer while a value or typed text is in the field.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | `--ds-background-input` fill with a `--ds-border-input` border. |
| Hovered | The border takes `--ds-border-focused`. |
| Focused | A 2px ring in `--ds-border-focused`, 2px off the box. |
| Invalid | The border takes `--ds-border-danger` and the input sets `aria-invalid`. |
| Read-only | The box takes `--ds-background-neutral`, at full contrast with no hover. The clear button and calendar icon are not drawn and a press opens no calendar (nor does a read-only filter trigger). The date can be read, selected and copied. |
| Disabled | The box fades to `--ds-opacity-disabled`, hides the clear button, and leaves the tab order. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Fill | `--ds-background-input`; read-only `--ds-background-neutral`. |
| Border | `--ds-border-input`; hovered `--ds-border-focused`; invalid `--ds-border-danger`. |
| Text | `--ds-text`; placeholder `--ds-text-subtlest`. |
| Icon and clear | Calendar icon `--ds-icon-subtle`; field clear icon `--icon-sm` on a subtle `IconButton`. |
| Footer Clear | Compact subtle `Button` at the end of the footer in `--dropdown-menu-pad` under a `--ds-border` top edge. |
| Focus ring | `--ds-border-focused`, 2px, 2px offset. |
| Popup gap | `--stack-sm`. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Name the date by its role: "Session date", "Start date". | A generic name: "Date", or "Pick a date". |
| Leave the placeholder as the format, MM/DD/YYYY. | Put an instruction in the placeholder: "Click to choose". |
| Say how to fix an invalid date: "Enter a date between October 5 and October 23". | "Invalid date". |
| Use sentence case in labels and messages. | Title case: "Session Date". |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `id` | string | — | Id of the input. Falls back to `name`, then to a generated id. |
| `name` | string | — | Form key. A hidden input under it submits the picked day as ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` (`start/end` with `range`), whatever text the field shows. |
| `placeholder` | string | — | Placeholder text |
| `value` | string or arrayOf | — | ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`; with `range`, `[start, end]`, either end may be `null`. |
| `defaultValue` | string or arrayOf | — | Initial value when uncontrolled. |
| `range` | bool | `false` | Pick a first and a last day |
| `presets` | bool or arrayOf or shape or string or func | `false` | Show preset ranges beside the calendar with Clear and Apply actions |
| `label` | string | — | Filter trigger label for the preset range popup |
| `trigger` | node or func | — | Custom trigger element or `({ isOpen, value, summary }) => node` for the filter popup. |
| `placement` | enum | `'bottom-start'` | Popup placement relative to a filter trigger. |
| `today` | string or instanceOf | — | Reference date used for relative presets and `lookBack`; defaults to today. |
| `lookBack` | bool | — | Disable days after `today`. Defaults to true when `presets` or a filter `label` is set. |
| `spacing` | enum | `'default'` | Field height: 40 default, 32 compact |
| `isDisabled` | bool | `false` | Disable the picker |
| `isReadOnly` | bool | `false` | Make read-only |
| `isInvalid` | bool | `false` | Draw the field invalid |
| `isValid` | bool | `false` | Draw the field valid |
| `minDate` | string or instanceOf | — | Optional minimum allowed date |
| `maxDate` | string or instanceOf | — | Optional maximum allowed date |
| `calendarAlign` | enum | `'left'` | Calendar dropdown alignment |
| `container` | object | — | Where a filter popup portals to; defaults to the page overlay layer. |
| `onChange` | func | — | `(iso)`, or `([start, end])` with `range`; `\'\'` or nulls when cleared. |
| `onFocus` | func | — | Called with the focus event when the input gains focus. |
| `onBlur` | func | — | Called with the blur event when the input loses focus, after any typed text has been checked. |
| `className` | string | `''` | Extra class on the field frame, beside `plus-date-picker`. |
| `style` | object | — | Inline style on the field frame. |
